import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('JD_AgeRelated_CpG_noMT_Final.csv')
lengths = pd.read_csv('JD_Chromosome_Length.csv', encoding='utf-8-sig')

# Filter methylation > 90% or < 10%
filt = (df['MethylationPercentage'] > 90) | (df['MethylationPercentage'] < 10)
filtered = df[filt]

# Get unique CpG positions
unique_cpgs = filtered[['Pos', 'Chromosome']].drop_duplicates()
print('Unique filtered CpGs:', len(unique_cpgs))
print()

# Count per chromosome
chr_counts = unique_cpgs['Chromosome'].value_counts()
print('Per-chromosome counts:')
print(chr_counts.sort_index())
print()

lengths['Chromosome'] = lengths['Chromosome'].astype(str)
merged = lengths.merge(chr_counts.reset_index(), left_on='Chromosome', right_on='index', how='left')
merged.columns = ['Chromosome', 'Length', 'idx', 'FilteredCpGCount']

merged = merged[['Chromosome', 'Length', 'FilteredCpGCount']]
print('All chromosomes with counts:')
print(merged.to_string())
print()

# Compute densities
merged['Density'] = merged['FilteredCpGCount'] / merged['Length']
print()
print('Average chromosomal density (mean of per-chromosome densities):', merged['Density'].mean())
print('Genomic density (total CpGs / total genome length):', merged['FilteredCpGCount'].sum() / merged['Length'].sum())
print()
print('Some per-chromosome densities:')
